title: Shape Morph
style: Geometry on a pale ground with a dot grid: one solid shape morphs circle → square → triangle → star → circle, rotating a little on each change, with three small coloured satellites orbiting it and a soft shadow. The dot grid ripples outward on each morph. A seamless loop.
learnsFrom: Shape-morph moments in code-made reels: a primitive that becomes every other primitive, satellites and a reactive dot grid.

story.what: a circle breathes at the centre; three satellites (accent red, blue, ink) orbit it; the dot grid pulses once
the circle snaps into a square with a quarter turn and an overshoot; the grid ripples outward from it
the square folds into a triangle; the satellites change orbit direction
the triangle bursts into a five-point star, the satellites flung wider, then pulled back
the star softens back into the circle; everything returns to its first position so frame 479 flows into frame 0

sizes: Landscape keeps the shape centred and adds the current shape's name in small mono on the left and a four-step indicator on the right.
sound: beatScore soft with loop:true at 120 bpm (tails wrap), a tick on each morph.
teaches: Morph between shapes by sampling each outline at the same number of points and interpolating point by point; spring the interpolation, not the points.

portable.style: Geometry on a pale ground with a dot grid: one solid near-black shape morphs circle → square → triangle → star → circle, rotating a little on each change, with three small coloured satellites orbiting it and a soft shadow beneath. Sample every outline at the same number of points and interpolate point by point with a spring. The dot grid ripples outward on each morph.
portable.sound: a soft loop at 120 bpm whose tails wrap around the end, with a tick on each morph.
portable.sizes: keep the shape centred, name the current shape in small mono on the left and show a four-step indicator on the right.
